title: Nondeterministic oracle exponential-time inclusion
statement: Every language decidable by a nondeterministic Turing machine with oracle 4\mathrm{EXPCOM}4 in time at most 4c(n^c+1)4 for some natural number 4c4 belongs to 4\mathrm{EXP}4, the class of languages decidable by a deterministic Turing machine in time at most 4d\,2^{n^d}4 for some natural number 4d4. Here 4\mathrm{EXPCOM}4 consists of strings encoding a machine description, an input, and a unary time bound 4n4, such that the described machine accepts that input within 4 2^n4 steps.
replaced:
Every language decidable by a nondeterministic oracle machine with oracle $	ext{EXPCOM}$
in time $n^c+1$, up to a constant factor for some $c\in\mathbb{N}$, belongs to
$	ext{EXP}$, the union over $d\in\mathbb{N}$ of deterministic time classes with bounds
proportional to $2^{n^d}$.
